name: Bayan Topics & Scriptural Evidence

meta.description: Read-only access to six introductory Islamic topics, vetted Hadith occurrences, and audience-tailored lesson formats with strict contract validation.

manifest.title: Bayan Topics & Scriptural Evidence
manifest.author: Hadith Project
manifest.description: Read-only access to six introductory Islamic topics, vetted Hadith occurrences, and audience-tailored lesson formats with strict contract validation.

specs.name: list_islam_topics
specs.description: List the six introductory topics for introducing Islam with core questions and subtopics.

specs.name: get_topic_evidence
specs.description: Retrieve vetted scriptural Hadith evidence occurrences, attributed rulings, and vocabulary for an introductory topic.

language.description: Output language: currently 'ar' only. Other languages return unavailable.

specs.name: get_reviewed_lesson
specs.description: Retrieve audience-tailored educational lesson content: 'card' (short card), 'qa' (Q&A), or 'two_minute' (narrative).

language.description: Output language: currently 'ar' only. Other languages return unavailable.

subtopic_id.description: Optional exact taxonomy subtopic ID; only explicitly mapped card lessons are supported. Unmapped requests return unavailable.
